title: Partner Configuration
content:
Purpose: Partner Configuration.

Technical details: Partner integrations have separate sandbox and production credentials, allowed endpoints, scopes, and webhook destinations. Changes require validation before deployment.

Operational guidance: Compare environment-specific configuration and audit history when a previously working integration fails.

Investigation evidence: Record affected services, timestamps, correlation identifiers, observed behavior, expected behavior, recent changes, and reproducible diagnostic steps.

Verification: Compare outcomes against documented requirements. Do not claim a root cause without supporting evidence. Document unresolved uncertainty and recommended follow-up.
